components.purpose: Outermost flex wrapper that lets short pages keep the footer at the bottom.
constraints: Use once as the outer page wrapper.
It has no size prop.

components.purpose: Sticky primary site navigation with desktop dropdowns and a mobile drawer.
constraints: Use real navigation data with href values.
Keep one interactive element per menu item.
Parents support one child level.

components.purpose: Keyboard bypass link from the top of the page to the main content.
constraints: Use with Main's id=main-content unless the target is deliberately customized.

components.purpose: Main content landmark with shared contained or full-width behavior.
constraints: Renders id=main-content for SkipLink.
Keep it after navigation and before supporting regions in reading order.

components.purpose: Semantic footer with optional links and shared width behavior.
Horizontal navigation between related pages below the Header.
constraints: Use real anchors for page navigation.
The mobile drawer renders the same items through LayoutProvider.
Do not use the Tabs primitive for page navigation.

components.purpose: Width-capped flex region that keeps Sidebar and Main aligned with page chrome.
constraints: Owns the width cap when Sidebar and Main are siblings.
Use Main size=full inside PageBody to avoid double-capping.

components.purpose: Persistent left navigation rail with labeled and icon-only variants.
constraints: Use only when persistent navigation earns its width.
The mobile drawer receives its data through LayoutProvider.

components.purpose: Shares secondary and sidebar navigation data between desktop slots and the mobile drawer.
constraints: Place outside PageShell when Header needs the context for MobileNav.

components.purpose: Responsive equal-width grid for repeated content.
constraints: Use container responsiveness inside SplitPane or other constrained regions.
Do not use for asymmetric primary/supporting layouts.

components.purpose: Responsive primary content plus supporting content arrangement.
constraints: Main content must be the first child.
Panes stack on narrow screens.
Use half inside Sidebar or Full layouts.

components.purpose: shadcn aria-nova primitives copied into the consuming application as needed.
constraints: Treat files as disposable generated output.
Keep application-specific behavior in wrappers or hand-written components outside ui/.

patterns.purpose: One primary content area without persistent secondary navigation.
recommendedWhen: A page has one main task.
Additional chrome would distract from the task.
avoidWhen: People need persistent access to many destinations.
Supporting details must remain visible beside the main task.

patterns.purpose: Primary shell with navigation between related peer sections.
recommendedWhen: The active section should remain visible on larger screens.
avoidWhen: There are only one or two destinations.
The navigation represents page-level headings rather than sibling pages.

patterns.purpose: Persistent navigation rail beside the main working or reading area.
recommendedWhen: People need frequent access to many destinations.
The navigation benefits from remaining visible while working.
avoidWhen: The page would become cramped at common widths.
The main task does not benefit from persistent context.
patterns.responsiveBehavior: The mobile drawer takes over navigation; the Sidebar is not treated as a second mobile menu.

patterns.purpose: Section navigation plus page-level navigation for content-heavy applications.
recommendedWhen: People need to understand where they are within a larger information set.
avoidWhen: The page is a focused transaction or simple task.

patterns.purpose: Primary content shown beside related details, filters, previews, or selected-item information.
recommendedWhen: Seeing both regions together improves the task.
The supporting content has a clear relationship to the primary content.
avoidWhen: The supporting content can be a separate page or a short disclosure.
constraints: Main first in DOM and reading order.
Stack vertically below the large breakpoint.
Use container-responsive Columns inside panes.

patterns.purpose: Search a bounded collection and recover clearly from validation, empty, and request-failure states.
recommendedWhen: People know words that may identify a record.
Results can be inspected as a short list.
avoidWhen: People need complex faceting or bulk data-grid operations.
A browse-first experience is more useful than search.
constraints: Keep the form available while showing results.
Use stable IDs for the form, field, submit button, and live status.
Preserve keyboard access and narrow-width reflow.

developer: Choose a pattern before copying individual components.
Resolve aliases, CSS tokens, and dependencies before wiring imports.
Keep router integration and application behavior outside the kit.
businessAnalyst: Describe the primary task and navigation needs before selecting a pattern.
Confirm the mobile fallback still supports the task.
designer: Choose contained or full chrome deliberately.
Define density, column counts, states, and responsive behavior.
Use semantic tokens instead of page-specific colors.
tester: Verify landmarks, keyboard behavior, responsive reflow, focus, active states, and no overflow.
Test the chosen pattern at 320px, desktop, keyboard, and dark theme.
Prefer semantic selectors and data-slot hooks over incidental classes.
aiAgent: Identify the task, then choose the simplest adequate pattern.
Use catalog file bundles and constraints before writing imports.
Preserve Main-first reading order and run the validation checklist.

updatePolicy.generatedFiles: src/components/ui files may be overwritten by shadcn regeneration.
updatePolicy.handWrittenFiles: src/components/layout files are kit-owned behavior and should be reviewed as API changes.
updatePolicy.consumerOwnership: Copied files belong to the consuming application.
futureArtifacts: registry or package after APIs stabilize
